    <node pkg="rosserial_python" name="chassis_node" type="serial_node.py" args="/dev/ttyACM0"/>

        <rosparam file="/home/tjark/ugv_sdk/config/joy/twist_mux_topics.yaml" command="load"/>
    </node>
